name: @pipeworx/mcp-world-port-index

tools.name: port_lookup
tools.description: Look up a port in the NGA World Port Index by name, UN/LOCODE, or WPI number. Returns WPI number, coordinates, harbor size/type, channel/anchorage/cargo-pier depths, and facilities. Refuses with an error if nothing matches.

name.description: Port name, e.g. "Rotterdam" (exact match preferred, falls back to substring)

wpi_number.description: NGA World Port Index port number, e.g. 31140

tools.name: ports_near
tools.description: Find NGA World Port Index ports within a radius of a lat/lon point, sorted nearest first, with distance in km.

tools.name: ports_by_country
tools.description: List NGA World Port Index ports for a country (name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), optionally filtered by harbor size (V/S/M/L).

country.description: Country name or ISO alpha-2 code, e.g. "Singapore" or "SG"

harbor_size.description: Filter by harbor size: V=Very small, S=Small, M=Medium, L=Large

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-world-port-index forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the world-port-index pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
